records.actionTitle: A. Briefing to/from the Commission and the Executive Director. (for discussion only)
records.sourceSnippet: . A. Briefing to/from the Commission and the Executive Director. (for discussion only) Executive Director Shellie Hughes shared news regarding the Department’s modernization project (MYNT). There are 116 days before MYNT phase one goes live. records.sourceSnippet: . 6. Suicide Screening – A screening by a trained staff member to confirm suicide risk, estimate immediate danger, and determine a course of treatment. Screening includes determining the student’s intent, history, plan, support systems, and other relevant factors. This tool should be grounded in research or evidence-based practice and approved by Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) and National Institute of Mental Health and can be used by clinicians, non-clinicians, and other trained individuals to identify individuals at risk for suicide..

records.actionTitle: 7. Suicide Attempt
records.sourceSnippet: . 7. Suicide Attempt A self-injurious behavior for which there is evidence that the person had at least some intent to kill himself or herself. A suicide attempt may result in death, injuries, or no injuries. A mixture of ambivalent feelings such as wish to die and desire to live is a common experience with most suicide attempts. Therefore, ambivalence is not a sign of a less serious or less dangerous suicide attempt. -- 25 of 79 -- 4 270reg.doc REGULATION No. 270 – CONTINUED.
